text: Which of the following is an example of a court judgment that affects the business environment?
options: The Companies Act, 2013
The Competition Act, 2002
The Supreme Court judgment in the case of Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages Pvt. Ltd. v. Government of Madhya Pradesh
The Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Act, 1969
correctAnswer: The Supreme Court judgment in the case of Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages Pvt. Ltd. v. Government of Madhya Pradesh
explanation: The Supreme Court judgment in the case of Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages Pvt. Ltd. v. Government of Madhya Pradesh is an example of a court judgment that affects the business environment. This judgment dealt with the issue of water pollution caused by the company's plant in Madhya Pradesh.

text: What is the main objective of the Competition Act, 2002?
options: To promote competition and prevent monopolies
To regulate the business environment
To protect the interests of consumers
To promote economic growth
correctAnswer: To promote competition and prevent monopolies
explanation: The main objective of the Competition Act, 2002 is to promote competition and prevent monopolies. This act aims to create a level playing field for businesses and prevent anti-competitive practices.
